input_contract.rule_scope: Owner-selected existing exact included156 syntax mappings only; no semantic/refinement/alias substitution.

registration_boundary: The original syntax-v1 ten fixtures, old91 analyses, expected diagnostics, known FP/FN controls and four plan identity strings remain unchanged. Additive registry/build/tests now select the two new cohorts.

The candidate connected loader validates fixed pinned bytes before JSON parsing, exact closed16 fixture membership and new fixture/matrix/schedule/hash joins. Duplicate/unknown/replaced JSON bytes fail the pinned-read gate, not a lenient fallback.

Full current authoring accounting is sixteen/145, while the original four identity strings preserve their historical ten/91 namespace. Old evidence is never renewed or transferred to the enlarged source tuple.
The same real provider/isolated runtime executes each selected case. No mock/fake detector, direct JVM bypass, model relabeling or alternate execution route is added.
Before execution, the owner must independently review/adopt and freshly compile/control-test the exact source/code/data image, then admit one selected plan and its resource budget.
The plan digest is data identity, not consent, capability, native execution proof, reproducible-build proof or stage evidence.

budgets.on_failure: Stop; retain raw partial artifacts and scratch/ancestors; no passing/live sidecar, no next reservation, no self-issued retry or process/supervisor cleanup.

enabled.required_sarif_descriptor: detekt. + upstream_id with colon replaced by dot

findings.compare: Exact multiset of selected rule/upstream IDs, path, one-based start/end lines and zero-based start/end-exclusive columns.
findings.file_digest: Each location must identify the exact captured source bytes.
findings.unexpected_diagnostics: Retain raw outputs and fail the authored expectation; do not drop, relabel, relax counts/ranges or silently regenerate expectations.
findings.known_heuristic_gap_controls: Anticipated FP/FN labels are source-authored intent, not observations. Actual FP findings remain in raw/normalized receipts; misses remain gaps even if the expected-output assertion passes.

changed_configuration_authorization_deni.changed_input: Same positive snapshot and old permit, selected rule disabled in a newly derived configuration-bound plan.
changed_configuration_authorization_deni.coverage: Exact requested rule, not_executed, not implemented/tested/qualified/successful; no findings.

cli_probe.when: After the first rule version replay and before its Common/Native requests; once freshly per cohort.

unsupported_target_abstention.when: After each version replay, following the fresh probe for the first rule.

snapshot_and_suppression.suppression: Actual @file:Suppress using the pinned upstream simple rule name on a package-isolated positive copy only; original Case.kt is byte-identical and retains every authored expected range.
snapshot_and_suppression.regression: Next standard analysis seals negative bytes as child of suppression, deletes SuppressedCase.kt, uses a distinct snapshot ID and verifies the registered parent plus child unchanged.

evidence_custody.start_witness_membership: Include the entire namespace (six fixtures, matrices, registry, scope, this contract and README), loader/control/provider/runtime source and actual loaded project code images plus all pinned Detekt/plugin artifacts and supervisor tuple.
evidence_custody.retain: Exact input/snapshot membership, source bytes and hashes, configuration bytes/digest, command/artifact pins, raw SARIF, stdout/stderr/process outcome, provider result, active descriptor, actual assertion/denial/abstention/version receipts, ordered budget progress and final external task outcome.
evidence_custody.publication: The existing runner may locally publish after its successful-test callback and final source/image/deadline gates, before the external task/build terminal is known. That local sidecar is not independent task completion proof: the owner must separately retain and verify the actual successful task terminal and exact run/source/code witnesses before accepting evidence. Explicit current owner execution authorization is still required. No sidecar is created by this proposal.
evidence_custody.old_rows: Historical evidence remains unchanged. An old rule unselected in the fresh selected-cohort context is explicitly not_run here; this never erases or imports its earlier execution state.
evidence_custody.selected_prior_live: Only the explicitly selected namespace live path may be withdrawn/replaced after retaining its exact prior bytes, under the existing anchored I/O rules. Never touch another/legacy cohort path from an expansion selection or any CURRENT pointer.

hash_contract.file_hashes: SHA-256 over the exact file bytes including their final LF.
hash_contract.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, compact comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=true, no trailing LF; arrays retain order.
hash_contract.source_set_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical_json of the complete fixture case sources object, not only the list of filenames.
hash_contract.plan_identity_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical_json of each cohorts.json plan_identity object; it binds exact fixture hashes, matrix, scope, this integration contract, limits and call counts.
